prompt: Edit image 1, a child's crayon drawing on paper, and keep everything in it exactly as it is: the same girl with brown hair, a yellow headband and a pink pinafore dress, the same tan dog with the blue checked blanket over its back, the same robot with the teal visor, square shoulders and the five coloured chest lights, the same green zigzag grass, the same crayon strokes, positions, sizes and paper texture. Add only this, in the same child's wax-crayon style: big, warm, loopy scribbles of yellow and orange glow drawn all around the robot's pink chest, radiating outward in rough rings and zigzag rays, layer on layer, so much glow that the scribbles cross the robot's arms and run right off the top edge and the right-hand edge of the picture. The glow is crayon on paper, flat, not a light effect and not a 3D render. The girl and the dog stay clear of the scribbles. No words, no letters, no new figures. Output one 16:9 image, 1280x720.
